process_tree_resources.model_pool_residency_estimate_mib: up to 5750 for two concurrent speech directions at 8192 MiB admission budget; this is an application estimate, not measured RSS
process_tree_resources.per_process_tree_cpu_rss_and_per_session: not measured; do not infer from root-only values

wall_clock_soak.admission: both routes required an 8192 MiB application admission budget; at 4096 MiB the second direction was rejected by memory admission
wall_clock_soak.failure: Both 1x sessions ended with retryable input_overload at approximately 1506–1514 wall-clock seconds (about 25 minutes), after about 75,000 20 ms frames each. The server reported 'Input queue is full; pace audio in real time'.
wall_clock_soak.resource_observation: Worker-pool resident estimate stayed at 5750 MiB and sampled pending jobs stayed at zero; global memory_pressure free percentage ranged approximately 41–48%. Session handles returned to zero after failure and idle worker residency later decreased.
wall_clock_soak.interpretation: Not an hour-soak pass. Stable sampled model residency did not prevent cumulative input queue delay and eventual overload.

real_browser.route_results: All five completed; text appeared in the page DOM. The zh_en speech route reported TTFO 7.64 s and playback queue drained.
real_browser.translated_speech_en_zh: Not rerun in this browser pass; a prior browser smoke record exists, but is not counted here.
